scenarios.prompt: Replay a committed semantic input tape twice at different render cadences while the game keeps its existing simulation clock. Record a versioned session report and compare only the declared stable oracle. Export a versioned stable trace; compare state/events and report first divergent tick and field.

criteria.ownership: Harness drives/observes execution while gameplay-validation owns what the session may prove.
criteria.clock: Adapter advances the project's existing logic tick and never invents a universal fixed timestep.
criteria.evidence: Session/build/adapter/oracle versions plus first divergent logical frame or event are inspectable.
criteria.production_handoff: Addresses the added production boundary in this prompt and distinguishes authored requirements from executed evidence.

scenarios.prompt: An old tape is replayed after input-schema and adapter revisions, and the render rate changes from 60 to 144 Hz. Require explicit tape/oracle migration or version mismatch rather than silently reinterpreting rows. Block comparisons with changed input/initial-state/clock/oracle/adapter/RNG identity; truncated traces cannot pass.

criteria.versioning: Tape, adapter and oracle versions are explicit and incompatible schemas fail closed or migrate deliberately.
criteria.determinism: Presentation cadence may change without changing canonical project logical rows for the recorded scope.
criteria.evidence: Mismatch reports preserve session identity, seed/save/input context and the first divergence.
criteria.production_handoff: Addresses the added production boundary in this prompt and distinguishes authored requirements from executed evidence.

scenarios.prompt: A request uses teleport and god mode, then calls the result a new-player clear because a human held the controller. It also proposes camera shake and particles as gameplay oracles. Reject those claims and reclassify the evidence. Never rewrite the golden automatically or call an offline trace comparison an engine run; keep failure attribution unknown until reproduced.

criteria.classification: Overrides force scripted evidence classification; human driver alone does not prove new-player usability.
criteria.oracle: Presentation-only systems are not gameplay truth unless their own contract is being tested.
criteria.ownership: Harness never authors combat timing, hit results, RNG, grants or save semantics to make the tape pass.
criteria.production_handoff: Addresses the added production boundary in this prompt and distinguishes authored requirements from executed evidence.
